Apollo11.note: writes the legacy `buy_tag`. freqtrade's `advise_entry` initialises `enter_tag` to "" and then renames `buy_tag` to `enter_tag`; renaming relabels rather than merges, so the frame comes back with two columns of that name. An ordinary backtest never notices, because it calls the hook once. `lookahead-analysis` calls it twice on the same frame - in `prepare_data` and again inside `backtest` - and the second pass has to align against a columns axis with a duplicate label, which pandas refuses: "cannot reindex on an axis with duplicate labels". The defect is freqtrade's own workaround meeting freqtrade's own rename; the strategy runs and trades in an ordinary backtest and its recursion is clean. The shim collapses the duplicate onto the last occurrence - the strategy's own tags - and was measured neutral on six of these rows: entry signals and tags identical with and without it, on runs carrying 138, 147 and 1956 entries. No strategy source is touched.

CryptoFrog.note: calls min_roi_reached_entry(trade_dur), freqtrade's signature before the hook gained trade and current_time. Those two are read only when use_custom_roi is set, which these predate, so the adapter fills them with None and the computed ROI is identical. The adapter raises rather than guessing if a caller does set use_custom_roi. No strategy source is touched. caches per-candle series in `custom_trade_info` inside `populate_indicators`, under the author's guard `if self.dp.runmode.value in ('backtest', 'hyperopt')`, and reads them back in `min_roi_reached_dynamic`. freqtrade registers the lookahead command as `setup_utils_configuration(args, RunMode.UTIL_NO_EXCHANGE)`, so under `lookahead-analysis` that guard is false, nothing is cached, and the strategy raises `KeyError: 'rmi-up-trend'` the moment its dynamic ROI is consulted. The analyzer does build a Backtesting object and run `backtest()` over real candles - it IS a backtest, and only its runmode label says otherwise. The shim rewrites UTIL_NO_EXCHANGE to BACKTEST on `DataProvider.runmode` alone, leaves `self.config['runmode']` untouched, and passes every other runmode through unchanged. No strategy source is touched.
